def solve_problem():

    lin_expr += 1.82 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=5.56, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 7.45 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.98, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 9.91 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.11, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 9.14 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.05, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 5.21 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.06, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 6.52 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=8.37, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 3.66 * vars['Var_6']
    vars['Var_7'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=15.03, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_7')
    lin_expr += 5.83 * vars['Var_7']
    vars['Var_8'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.31, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_8')
    lin_expr += 2.61 * vars['Var_8']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(8.3 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.97 * vars['Var_2'] + 9.39 * vars['Var_3'] + 7.6 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.81 * vars['Var_7'] + 2.52 * vars['Var_8'] >= 175.99, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(9.8 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.67 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.52 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.68 * vars['Var_4'] + 8.62 * vars['Var_5'] + 5.02 * vars['Var_6'] + 6.47 * vars['Var_8'] >= 199.89, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(7.1 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.34 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.35 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.32 * vars['Var_4'] + 1.37 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.34 * vars['Var_6'] + 0.38 * vars['Var_8'] >= 134.64, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(9.7 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.68 * vars['Var_2'] + 5.19 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.53 * vars['Var_7'] + 8.93 * vars['Var_8'] >= 181.88, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(3.33 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.82 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.69 * vars['Var_2'] + 5.15 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.17 * vars['Var_8'] >= 81.33, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(9.7 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.2 * vars['Var_1'] + 5.21 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.14 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.93 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.79 * vars['Var_5'] + 8.35 * vars['Var_6'] + 1.46 * vars['Var_7'] >= 173.54, name='C5')

    m.optimize()
